status: Proposed wording for user review; not approved, tested, frozen or adopted.
change: Add one instruction after the quoted-text interpretation instruction. All other wording and input formatting remain unchanged.
added_sentence: Interpret names and tags using context and established meaning; do not assume that their words literally describe what they refer to.
hypothesis: The recurring commercial-chain titles may reflect treating a name's component words as an established literal description. Distinguishing contextual or established meaning from that assumption may improve title fidelity without requiring an example-specific answer.
evidence: V22's completed comparison returned Coffee shop chains twice and Coffee chains once. Supplying the true social-media source setting did not yield a clear correction. Earlier removal of the wording/format instruction also did not resolve the commercial interpretation.
limitation: Outputs do not establish the model's internal mechanism. If it treats the disputed interpretation as established meaning, this instruction may not change its answer. It must also preserve valid interpretations of genuinely descriptive names and tags.
unchanged: Source context, per-instance support, relationship clarity, wording/format rule, masks, model choice and existing results remain unchanged. No source-platform hint, example, preferred title, preprocessing or generated output is added.
approval_boundary: The user requested a proposed change. This candidate is prepared for delta review only. No model calls, title replacement or TRUE execution are authorized by this proposal.
guidance_scope: Official guidance supports stating clear output requirements. This particular semantic distinction is an experimental hypothesis, not a recommendation established by the guidance.
